profile_rationale: Small target: about 940 lines of backend Python (FastAPI + psycopg) plus a small React SPA (frontend/src). The quick profile is the skill's recommended fit for small targets. This is a partial pass: one hunter wave and one final coverage critic.

planned_agents.verifiers: one per surviving candidate (quick profile merges Phase 3 and Phase 5)

reconnaissance_note: Deviation from RECONNAISSANCE.md: the four reconnaissance roles (1a-1d) were performed directly by the parent, which read the whole in-scope source (small enough to read in full) instead of delegating to four research agents. Recon facts are summarized in architecture.md.

sandbox_capability.blocker: Host is Windows 11 with Git Bash/PowerShell. No OS-enforced sandbox is available that can provide all of: no external network, empty allowlisted environment, read-only target and toolchain, scratch-only writes, and CPU/memory/process/disk/wall-clock limits. Node also exposes no O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK here, so the race-safe artifact promotion procedure cannot be enforced either.
sandbox_capability.consequence: No target-controlled code (pytest, uvicorn, vite, harnesses) was executed. All checks are source-only (method: source, artifact: null). Because the confirmed verdict requires a bounded local observed result, no record can reach confirmed in this run; source-complete candidates are recorded as needs_validation with the sandbox blocker.

validator_note: validate-coverage-ledger.cjs and validate-findings.cjs refuse to read any file on this platform (no O_NOFOLLOW). Run files are parent-written, not target-controlled, so they are validated with a wrapper that does an lstat regular-file/non-symlink check and then calls the validators' exported validateDocument() functions unchanged.
prior_runs_note: No prior coverage-ledger.json or findings.json exists for this repository.
